column.description: 1-based column of start, counted in characters.

quote.description: The document bytes from start to end, copied exactly.

nodes.description: Expression nodes. A member that holds an expression holds an index into this array. Every index must exist, a node's children have greater indexes than the node, and every node is named exactly once by the rule or by one other node.

anyOf.description: Use only when no other node expresses the operation. A rule that holds it is stored with a blocking Unsupported finding.

spans.description: Must repeat the evidence one for one in the same order.
